changes.title: Albuquerque Site and Building Design Considerations

scope_assessment.specific_albuquerque_connection: Four-page Albuquerque Site and Building Design Considerations contains eighteen locally tailored climate/geography design principles and detailed summer/winter solar analysis performance criteria. Although it includes evaluation boxes/signature fields, its substantial core is design guidance tied to Albuquerque climate, Sandia views, vegetation and IDO 5-2(D)(1), not a blank transaction form.
